title: Log Fabric TF Module: unified VPC log shipper, tiered S3 archive, OpenSearch ILM integration
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a reusable Terraform module (log-fabric) to standardize VPC and account-level telemetry ingestion for Private deployments. The module will: ingest CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, GuardDuty findings and application logs; centralize routing to customer-owned S3 buckets with configurable lifecycle tiers (hot S3 -> warm S3-IA -> Glacier/Glacier Deep Archive); optionally index a rolling subset into OpenSearch with ILM policies; provision cross-account IAM roles for centralized collectors; enable KMS encryption for S3 and snapshot encryption for OpenSearch; expose metrics and healthchecks. The module must be registry-friendly (Terraform 1.5), support backwards-compatible inputs for our existing stacks, and include import scripts and a staged upgrade path for customers currently running legacy logging stacks.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module published to internal registry and consumed by two test VPCs
CloudTrail + VPC Flow ingestion works end-to-end into S3 and optional OpenSearch indexing
S3 lifecycle transitions execute in test account (hot -> IA -> Glacier) per policy
Module exposes CloudWatch metrics and a Lambda healthcheck that verifies OpenSearch _cat/indices and S3 inventory completion
Upgrade path documented with terraform import examples and migration checklist
KMS keys are created with correct least-privilege policies; security review completed
migration_plan: Phase 1: Publish module and run in parallel for new VPCs (no cutover)
Phase 2: Offer terraform import scripts and a one-click migration runbook for teams with legacy buckets
Phase 3: Coordinate canary migration for 2 pilot customers and validate billing/queries
Phase 4: Gradual cutover schedule with rollback steps and snapshot-based recovery for OpenSearch indices
runbooks: Runbook: verify-shipper-lambda.md (Lambda-based healthcheck to check S3 inventory and OpenSearch status)
Runbook: rollback-log-fabric.md (how to revert to legacy ingestion and restore indices)

2026-03-02 Security review: Requested explicit S3 bucket policies to deny public ACLs and enforce SSE-KMS. Also flagged need for CI-based static analysis of IAM statements.
2026-03-05 Design feedback from Platform: prefer using S3 Inventory + Athena for long-term OLAP queries rather than indexing everything in OpenSearch; we'll provide optional OLAP config.
2026-03-08 QA: End-to-end test failed intermittently — S3 lifecycle rule applied but Glacier transition did not complete in sandbox due to object tagging mismatch. Added tagging step to module.
2026-03-12 Arjun Patel: Addressed security feedback, added terraform tests, updated docs. PR #1124 opened for infra repo. Marking status In Progress and targeting release private-2026.03.
notes: Trade-offs: indexing fewer fields reduces ES cost but requires a stable export pipeline for analytics (S3 + Athena). We will ship both with opt-in default to S3-first + selective ES indexing.
Rollback: snapshots of indices + S3 object lifecycle can be used to restore if migration fails; include snapshot schedule in module.
Testing: acceptance harness uses localstack for S3 lifecycle, mocked OpenSearch for index templates, and integ tests run in ephemeral AWS accounts via CI
